title: The ferry in the paper
logline: A newspaper on Gully's counter open to a photo of a Seattle ferry, and a coffee ring on the photo. The page's only Seattle since the Rooms. Whose coffee: the end stool's.

panels.composition: A newspaper open on a shop counter to a photo of a ferry on gray water, a coffee ring printed across the photo, the end stool's edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a newspaper open on a shop counter to a photograph of a ferry on gray water with a coffee ring across the photo, the edge of a stool beside it, no words legible

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards

notes: The only Seattle since the Rooms.
